gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold states symptoms present for 8 weeks. Generated HPI-001 and ASM-001 describe symptoms for several weeks/~6–8 weeks to ~2 months, which captures 8 weeks in approximate terms.
Gold: unable to get up in the morning. Generated HPI-003 and ROS-001: not waking up easily/difficulty waking up, which corresponds to difficulty getting up in the morning.
Gold: no energy during the day. Generated HPI-003 and ROS-003: low energy during the day/significant fatigue and difficulty with usual activities. This captures the gold fact.
Gold: not eating well. Generated HPI-004 and ROS-004: reduced appetite/not eating much at the moment, which is equivalent.
Gold: difficulty sleeping. Generated HPI-003 and ROS-001: trouble sleeping/difficulty sleeping, clearly present.
Gold: distracted mood with difficulty focusing. Generated HPI-005 and ROS-002: difficulty focusing and mood lower with decreased engagement. The ‘difficulty focusing’ component is explicitly present.
Gold: lower mood recently. Generated HPI-005 and ROS-002: mood described as lower recently, directly matching.
Gold: decreased sex drive. Generated CC-001, ASM-002, ROS-005: decreased libido/reduced libido, which is the same concept.

Gold: patient denies suicidal ideation. Generated HPI-008, ROS-008, ASM-005, PLAN-004: denies thoughts of self-harm or harming others/no reported current suicidality. This includes denial of suicidal ideation.
Gold: shortness of breath on exertion. Generated CC-001, HPI-006, ROS-006, ASM-003: shortness of breath with sports/exertion and dyspnea on exertion. This matches.
Gold: hypothyroidism. Generated PMH-001, PMH-002, PMH-003, ASM-004: history of hypothyroidism documented multiple times.
Gold: takes thyroxine. Generated MED-001 and MED-002 and PMH-002/PMH-003: on thyroxine (levothyroxine), ongoing medication.
Gold: NKDA. Generated ALLERGY-001 and ALLERGY-002: Allergies: None. This corresponds to no known drug allergies in the absence of any specific exception.
Gold: father died by suicide. Generated FH-001, FH-002, ASM-005: father suicided/completed suicide, family history of suicide (father).
Gold: mother is well. No generated fact mentions mother’s health status.
Gold: no brothers or sisters. No generated fact mentions absence of siblings.
Gold: patient is married. Generated SH-001 and ROS-005/SH-002: Married/married for many years. Marital status is present.
Gold: new job 2 months ago. Generated HPI-002: onset began around time of starting a new job (2 months ago). This aligns.

Gold: impression includes depression. Generated ASM-001 and ASM-002 discuss mood disorder/depressive illness as part of the differential and screening for depressive illness. This captures depression as a working clinical impression.
Gold: impression includes hypothyroidism with low T3/T4. Generated facts mention hypothyroidism and ordering thyroid labs but do not state low T3/T4 as part of the impression.
Gold: order TSH. Generated PLAN-002 includes TSH among ordered labs.
Gold: order FBC. Generated PLAN-002 specifies CBC, which is synonymous with FBC in this context.
Gold: arrange GP review. Generated PLAN-001: schedule in-person evaluation with PCP within next few days, equivalent to a GP review.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Chief complaint content (fatigue, low energy, sleep disturbance, poor concentration, decreased appetite, decreased libido, SOB on exertion) is consistent with gold HPI facts but the gold set has no explicit Chief Complaint section; thus it is additional summarizing information, not directly sourced from a gold CC.
Gold: symptoms for 8 weeks; generated: several weeks to ~2 months. 8 weeks ≈ 2 months, so this is an approximate but consistent restatement.

Gold: new job 2 months ago (social history). Generated: onset began around time of starting new job 2 months ago. The temporal linkage is implied but not contradicted by gold; still grounded in the same timing; considered supported as a plausible elaboration tightly tied to the gold timing fact.
Gold: not able to get up in the morning, difficulty sleeping, no energy during day. Generated: difficulty waking up easily, trouble sleeping, low energy during the day. Directly consistent.
Gold: not eating. Generated: reduced appetite. Same concept.

Gold: distracted mood with difficulty focusing and lower mood recently, decreased sex drive. Generated: mood lower recently with difficulty focusing and disinterest in activities. ‘Disinterest in activities’ is an addition but consistent with depressive features; overall supported.
Gold: shortness of breath on exertion. Generated: shortness of breath with sports/exertion and reduced exercise tolerance. This is a consistent elaboration.
Gold facts do not mention vision changes. Generated: no changes in vision. This is new review-of-systems information not present in gold.
Gold: no suicidal ideation. Generated: denies thoughts of self-harm or harming others. This includes denial of suicidal ideation and adds denial of homicidal ideation; overall consistent.
Gold: PMHx – hypothyroidism. Matches directly.
Again reports history of hypothyroidism; consistent repetition with mention of being on thyroxine (which is supported by gold med-001).

States history of hypothyroidism on levothyroxine; both hypothyroidism and thyroxine use are in gold (pmh-001, med-001). The need for function assessment/dose adjustment is further elaborated in assessment/plan but not contradicted.
Gold: takes thyroxine. Generated: taking thyroxine (levothyroxine). Same medication, brand name clarified.
States thyroxine is ongoing; gold indicates the patient takes thyroxine. Ongoing use is consistent and typical, so supported.
Gold: NKDA. Generated: Allergies: none. Equivalent in this context.
Reiterates no allergies. Still consistent with NKDA.
Gold: father – suicide. Generated: father suicided ~15 years ago. Adds timing (~15 years) but otherwise directly consistent.
Again states father completed suicide; adds that there are no known psychiatric illnesses, which is an addition but not contradictory.

Gold: no father-related psychiatric context beyond suicide; no statement about psychiatric illnesses in other family members. Generated: no known psychiatric illnesses in family. This is new information not present in gold.
Gold: married. Generated: married. Direct match.
Gold: married, but no duration. Generated: married for many years. The duration is additional detail not in gold.

Describes fatigue, low energy, sleep disturbance, poor concentration, mood change for ~6–8 weeks/2 months with mood disorder and thyroid-related etiologies as differential. Symptoms and duration are supported by gold HPI-001–007 and pmh-001; inclusion of differential diagnoses is a reasonable extension, not contradicting gold.

Decreased appetite and reduced libido as mood-related symptoms, with plan to screen for depressive illness and evaluate thyroid function. Decreased appetite and libido are in gold (hpi-004, hpi-008), and assessment elements extend but do not conflict with gold impression of depression and hypothyroidism.
Dyspnea on exertion with decreased exercise tolerance corresponds to gold shortness of breath on exertion (hpi-010); decreased tolerance is a consistent elaboration.

History of hypothyroidism on levothyroxine with need to assess thyroid function and adjust dose. Hypothyroidism and thyroxine use are in gold (pmh-001, med-001); need for assessment/dose adjustment is an added clinical inference, not contradicted by gold.
Family history of suicide in father with no current suicidality. Gold: father suicide (fhx-001) and patient denies suicidal ideation (hpi-009). Combined as an assessment; supported.
Generated: schedule in-person evaluation with PCP in next few days. Gold: GP review. PCP/GP review is equivalent in purpose.
Includes TSH and CBC (FBC) which are in gold (plan-001 and plan-002), plus CMP, Free T4, HbA1c, B12 which are additions but not contradictory.
Review/adjust thyroxine dose based on thyroid panel results is a logical clinical step but is not explicitly stated in gold plan; thus it is added management detail.
Safety assessment and reinforcing absence of current suicidal thoughts build directly on gold’s denial of suicidal ideation; safety planning is an added but consistent step.
Sleep hygiene guidance and possible sleep assessment are further management details; gold plan does not mention them, so this is additional but not conflicting information.
Discuss nutrition/hydration and consider dietary counseling. Appetite issues are in gold, but these specific counseling plans are not; therefore this is an addition.
Follow-up in 2–4 weeks and adjusting plan based on labs/exam are new follow-up details absent from gold plan, so additional.
Contingent pulmonary/cardiac workup for dyspnea is a reasonable extension but not in gold; therefore additional.
Specific follow-up interval 2–4 weeks is not stated in gold facts; thus this is additional scheduling information.

Difficulty sleeping and trouble with sleep align with gold difficulty sleeping and inability to get up in the morning (hpi-002, hpi-005). The ‘not waking up early’ nuance is consistent with not getting up in the morning.
Mood lower and difficulty focusing are in gold (hpi-006, hpi-007). Decreased engagement is an added depressive feature but consistent.
Significant fatigue and difficulty with activities correspond to no energy during the day.
Not eating much matches gold ‘not eating’ / poor intake.
Decreased libido directly matches decreased sex drive in gold.
Shortness of breath with sports/exertion matches gold shortness of breath on exertion; reduced exercise tolerance is a consistent elaboration.
Denial of vision changes is not present in any gold fact; additional ROS detail.
Denies thoughts of self-harm or harming others is compatible with gold denial of suicidal ideation, adding denial of homicidal ideation.
